correctness.rationale: The only nonzero posets on three elements extending a least element yield exactly five four-element meet-semilattice isomorphism types. Independently enumerated all 2^6 labeled directed orders, filtered partial orders with meets and isomorphisms, then all 2^12 reflexive relations for each type, checking coordinatewise meet closure and congruence equivalence. Exact (D,C) values in flat-star, one-comparability, common-lower, Boolean diamond, chain order: (322,8),(400,8),(625,8),(306,7),(576,8). Reproduced all five full size-polynomial coefficient vectors and pairwise distinct chi values. Both the theorem and verification concern precisely four-element meet-semilattices, not asymptotics or all orders.

value.rationale: The possible chi values for semilattices are posed as a natural problem by Barber–Ruškuc. An exhaustive first genuinely nontrivial five-isomorphism-type spectrum, the exceptional seven-congruence diamond, full relation-size polynomials and separation of every type by chi are useful small-order benchmark facts, not an arbitrary slice of an unmotivated statistic.
